caption: Diagram 9 Discharge capacities of foul drains running 0.75 proportional depth
description: This is a line chart titled "Diagram 9 Discharge capacities of foul drains running 0.75 proportional depth". The vertical axis is labelled "Flow rate [litres per second]" and is marked 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 20 and 30 from bottom to top, with gridlines at each value. The horizontal axis is labelled "Gradient [1 in ...]." and is marked 1:10, 1:20, 1:30, 1:50, 1:70, 1:100 and 1:200 from left to right. Three straight lines slope downwards from left to right, each labelled with a pipe size. The upper line, "150mm diameter", runs from about 30 at 1:30 to about 12 at 1:100. The middle line, "100mm diameter", runs from 20 at 1:10 to about 6 at 1:70. The lower line, "75mm diameter", runs from about 8 at 1:10 to 3 at 1:70. For any given gradient, the larger diameter line lies above the smaller one.
